description: M02-U11 case index (m02-plan revision 5 §3, §4): every exit case and claim mapped to its Cargo test targets and tests, per platform. tests: {target: [name | prefix*] | "*"}; a name ending in '*' matches every test whose full name or last segment starts with the rest, and '*' alone is the whole target. Patterns are resolved into required-inventory.json from the build host's sources (m02-evidence.py --generate-inventory) and never from run logs. platform_only: {"<target>" | "<target>::<test prefix>": [platforms]} limits where a test exists (#[cfg] gating, read from the cross-built binaries' symbols with platform-tests.py). build_host_paths: tests that read the repository at its compile-time path; remote harnesses skip them, a neutral one counts as run on the build host, any other is a harness gap that keeps the row in_progress. child_entries: #[ignore]d child-process entry points, never required. scenario_targets: harness-defined steps (not Cargo tests) logged in the same format. observation_targets: the Cargo test targets whose tests print `observation` lines (ADR-0007 [I]/[U] facts: exchange and birth-time support, client and Git observations); every remote run uses --show-output, and run-macos.sh runs these once more through cargo with --show-output because check.sh discards passing output. blocked_rows: per case, the platform rows that need an owner input (m02-plan §7), always blocked with that input named.
